hypotheses: For each n, regulator Schwinger functionals S_{n,a} are continuous on Schwartz space S(R^{4n}).
There exist C_n and a continuous Schwartz seminorm p_N with |S_{n,a}(f)| <= C_n p_N(f), uniformly in a and volume after thermodynamic passage.
T7_schwinger_compactness_from_uniform_se.conclusion: Along every sequence a_j->0 there is a common subnet/subsequence for all n whose S_{n,a_j} converge weak-* in S prime to tempered distributions S_n. Positivity and every finite linear identity continuous in this topology pass to the limit.
T7_schwinger_compactness_from_uniform_se.proof: The uniform seminorm bound puts the family in C_n times the polar of a zero-neighborhood. Alaoglu-Bourbaki gives weak-* compactness. Use product compactness/diagonal extraction over countably many n and test families.

hypotheses: For every centered vector in a dense OS cylinder domain, C_a(t)=int exp(-tE) dmu_a(E) and C_a(t) <= M_a exp(-m t) with fixed m>0.
C_a(t)->C(t) and norms M_a remain locally bounded; the OS limit gives a positive spectral measure mu.
T8_uniform_euclidean_decay_transfers_spe.conclusion: mu((0,m))=0 for every such vector; density gives Spec(H) cap (0,m)=empty.
T8_uniform_euclidean_decay_transfers_spe.proof: For epsilon>0, mu([0,m-epsilon]) exp(-t(m-epsilon)) <= C(t) <= M exp(-mt). Hence mu([0,m-epsilon]) <= M exp(-epsilon t)->0 as t->infinity. Union over rational epsilon.

hypotheses: ker H is the one-dimensional vacuum
T9_mass_finiteness_from_nontrivial_uniqu.conclusion: If H has a positive gap, its mass m=sup{Delta: Spec(H) cap (0,Delta)=empty} is finite.
T9_mass_finiteness_from_nontrivial_uniqu.proof: A non-vacuum vector has a nonzero spectral measure supported in (0,infinity). A self-adjoint operator has spectrum in R, so that measure has support at at least one finite positive spectral value E; therefore m<=E<infinity.

hypotheses: Base finite-volume action has Bakry-Emery curvature Hess V + Ric >= K I with K>0, uniformly in volume.
Added C2 interaction Phi obeys Hess Phi >= -epsilon I with epsilon<K, uniformly in volume.
T10_bakry_emery_terminal_stability.conclusion: Perturbed action has curvature >=(K-epsilon)I and inherits the corresponding volume-uniform Poincare/log-Sobolev lower margin.
T10_bakry_emery_terminal_stability.proof: Hess(V+Phi)+Ric >= K I-epsilon I=(K-epsilon)I; apply Bakry-Emery criterion.

hypotheses: R -> S_n(f composed with R) is continuous for each Schwartz test f
S_n invariant under a dense subgroup D of a Lie symmetry group K
T11_dense_symmetry_extension.proof: For R in K choose R_j in D with R_j->R; continuity gives S_n(f o R)=lim S_n(f o R_j)=S_n(f).

hypotheses: Regulator moments satisfy permutation symmetry and reflection positivity on the cylinder domain
Uniform seminorm bounds give tempered limit distributions
Euclidean covariance and clustering have regulator-uniform limiting estimates
T12_os_axioms_closed_under_distributiona.conclusion: Symmetry, temperedness, reflection positivity, covariance and clustering pass to the limiting Schwinger family; the standard OS reconstruction theorem applies.
T12_os_axioms_closed_under_distributiona.proof: Each finite algebraic identity passes by distributional convergence; positivity passes as a closed quadratic inequality; decay bounds pass by limsup; temperedness is T7.
